verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a payments platform with an API, SDK, and MCP server, but the evidence documents only single-item operations: creating one checkout and refunding one transaction. The claim of simultaneous transactions on multiple Solo readers describes parallel in-person processing across devices, not a user-driven batch operation over many items, so it does not count here. No batch endpoints, bulk refunds, or bulk MCP or agent tools are evidenced.
